time.expression: O(n^2) online real operations; O(n^2/P) per processor

space.expression: Offline matrices and fresh perturbation vector

notes: The scalar width is controlled by the largest singular value, not the longest Gram–Schmidt vector. Publication year is known; the detailed theorem was checked in the 2011 full author version.

extra.width: Covariance Sigma > r^2 B B^T, r=omega(sqrt(log n)); spherical sufficient condition s > r s_1(B)

extra.output: One sample on L+c, arbitrary real shift c
extra.model: Theorem 4.2: P <= n^2 processors; O(n^2/P) sufficiently precise real operations per processor
